title: Leyton Emergency Help Points
summary: Immediate medical guidance, Lea river flood zones, and essential resources across Leyton (E10).
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 first. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: Whipps Cross Hospital, Whipps Cross Road, Leytonstone E11 1NR. Travel guidance: from Leyton Midland Road station, ~25 min walk east via High Road Leyton and Lea Bridge Road / Whipps Cross Road, or take bus 257 or W16. Homerton University Hospital, Homerton Row, Hackney E9 6SR. Travel guidance: from Leyton Underground station, ~30 min walk west across Temple Mills / Lea Valley, or take bus 308 towards Homerton. For major trauma, The Royal London Hospital (Major Trauma Centre), Whitechapel Road, Whitechapel E1 1FR. 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: Whipps Cross Urgent Treatment Centre, Whipps Cross Road, E11 1NR. Oliver Road Polyclinic (Urgent Care / Minor Illness), 75 Oliver Road, Leyton E10 5LG. 3. Area Hazards: River Lea corridor, Orient Way lowlands, and Dagenham Brook channels with significant surface water and river flooding risks around Lea Bridge Road. 4. Essential Supplies: Dispensing pharmacies and major supermarkets along High Road Leyton, Lea Bridge Road, and Oliver Road maintain shelf stocks of water, emergency light sources, and medication during outages. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
